title: Grits with Cheese, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: Grits with cheese, no added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product made from whole grain grits, mild cheese and seasonings. It is prepared without any added vegetable or animal fats, preserving the natural taste of the grain and a subtle creamy note from the cheese.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grits are one of the few grains naturally gluten‑free.
The cheese used is typically low‑fat cottage or processed cheese, keeping the calorie count low.
Grits contain antioxidants such as rutin, which supports vascular health.
Traditionally grits are cooked as a porridge, but the ready‑to‑eat version is convenient for on‑the‑go consumption.
Combining grits with cheese provides a complete amino‑acid profile.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Together, grits and cheese deliver about 12 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fats makes this product suitable for low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: Contains iron and magnesium
items.content: Grits are a good source of iron and magnesium, essential for blood formation and nerve function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber in grits promotes intestinal motility and helps you feel fuller longer.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Grits raise blood sugar slowly, which is beneficial for people managing diabetes.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The cheese component may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Grits contain oxalates, which can contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible individuals.

items.title: Sodium in cheese
items.content: Some cheese varieties may have higher salt levels; those monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be enjoyed as a snack, added to salads, soups, or used as a filling for wraps. If desired, heat in the microwave for 30‑40 seconds.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. After opening, consume within 5‑7 days. Discard if any off‑smell, mold, or taste change occurs.
